signatures.description: Uses Windows utilities for basic Windows functionality

T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial'>How are you?
text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial'>It is a pleasure to be in contact with your esteemed company. My name is Ritter Thomas the purchase Manager of UNICAT GMBH, Germany.

text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial'> Due to the recent increase in demand of your product  in our local market,  kindly send us your updated price list and catalog, MOQ for our purchase reference and let us know your possible delivery time and terms of payment.

text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial'>I await your soonest feedback so that we can take the final decision in our next order approval and discuss the best prices and possible trade coperation with you.

text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial'>Best Regards.
Thomas. Ritter
